description.description: What this hooks file does, shown when searching hooks

share.description: Share hooks files of this repository: `hooker search` finds the root configs with this field on GitHub (root config only)

params.description: Parameters of a reusable hooks file, used as `{{name}}` in its hooks and set with `with` by the hook loading it

imports.description: Sub-projects folders, each one with its own hooker.config.json. Globs are supported (packages/*)

discover.description: Load every hooker.config.json of the repository (files ignored by git are skipped)

parallel.description: Run hooks in parallel (root config only)

variables.description: Variables shared between hooks: a hook declares the ones it `writes` (`echo "name=value" >> $HOOKER_VARS`) and `reads` (`$name`). Their values are kept between runs

Share.description: Hooks files shared by this repository

tags.description: Keywords to find them (rust, lint, commits...)

hooks.description: Shared hooks files, relative to the repository root. Globs are supported (hooks/*.json)

Param.description: A parameter of a reusable hooks file

default.description: Value used when `with` doesn't set it (required without it)
Value before any hook writes it

writers.description: Hooks allowed to write it: `name`, `project:name` or `*` (default: every hook)

readers.description: Hooks allowed to read it: `name`, `project:name` or `*` (default: every hook)

trigger.description: Git hook that runs this hook (not used with `path`)

include.description: Glob patterns, relative to the config folder. Without it, the hook targets all files

exclude.description: Glob patterns of files to ignore

cmd.description: Shell command, run from the config folder. {files} is replaced by the targeted files

stage_fixed.description: Re-stage the targeted files after the hook (for formatters)

from.description: Git repository URL to load the hooks file from (requires `path`)

rev.description: Branch or tag of `from` (default branch if missing)

path.description: Hooks file to load, relative to the config folder (or to the root of `from`)

with.description: Values of the `params` of the hooks file loaded with `path`

needs.description: Hooks this one waits for: `name`, `name/step` or `project:name` (same trigger)

inputs.description: Values from other hooks, available as `{name}` and `$name` in commands: `{ "name": "hook.output" }` (outputs: files, stdout, status or a declared output)

steps.description: Steps of this hook, each one can wait for the others

reads.description: Variables this hook reads, available as `$name` (it runs after the hooks writing them)

permissions.description: What this hook is allowed to do. Without it, a hook of the repository can do everything and a hook loaded with `from` can only read files

Step.description: A step of a hook: a node of the graph

id.description: Step id, unique in the hook

needs.description: Steps (or hooks) this one waits for

inputs.description: Values from other steps or hooks: `{ "name": "step.output" }`

Permissions.description: What a hook is allowed to do

files.description: `read`: the targeted files can't be modified (changes are reverted and the hook fails), `write`: they can

network.description: Network access. When false, it is blocked where the system allows it (Linux user namespaces, macOS sandbox)

env.description: Environment variables the hook gets, besides the basic ones (PATH, HOME, GIT_*...). Without it, a hook of the repository gets all of them

FileAccess.description: Access of a hook to the files of the repository

oneOf.description: The files may not be modified (checked after the hook, changes are reverted)
